title: Purple Mountain Night Watch
premise: A long astronomical drama under the cold light of the summit dome and Schmidt-Cassegrain telescope. Shen Xiaolan and Shen Xiaoxing are easily confused by looks; the telescope goes intact→cracked→recoated; after Beidou One crashes it must be avoided; count memory, false friends, and temporal flashbacks run throughout. Human-readable context only; never fed to the SUT.
_comment: Author layer: humans only write entities + state machines + per-scene timelines (present + handwritten action + semantic events). present items may be objects carrying confusable_with/count/anchor. op/gap/probe/forbidden are derived by complete_gt.py.
_state_note: Entities with state machines use states; entities without use appearance. On transition inject only the current-state look. Flashbacks may set state on a present item to point at a past state.

states.prime_nightwatch: Observatory night watchman Lu Heng around fifty, salt-and-pepper short hair, deep-blue cold-weather coat under an orange reflective vest, walkie-talkie at the waist, thick hands, gaze sharp yet weary.
states.injured_cane: The same Lu Heng after injury: gauze stitched at the temple, left leg in a splint, walking slowly on an aluminum cane, still in that faded deep-blue cold-weather coat.
states.deceased: Lu Heng has closed his eyes in death, lying still on the infirmary narrow bed, face peaceful, no breath left.

states.young_intern: Young Shen Xiaolan: a lean fifteen-year-old observatory intern, silver-rim glasses, gray-blue coveralls, a cyan 'Lan' cloth badge sewn on the left sleeve, eyes bright and stubborn.
states.adult_assistant: Adult Shen Xiaolan: a tall upright observing assistant of twenty-three or twenty-four, still in silver-rim glasses with cyan 'Lan' badge on the left sleeve, manner steady.

states.coated_intact: A Schmidt-Cassegrain telescope on an equatorial mount, matte-black tube intact, primary coating reflecting cold blue light, guidescope aligned beside it.
states.tube_cracked: The same Schmidt-Cassegrain telescope with a lengthwise crack in the tube, a patch of primary coating peeled, beam scattered by the gap.
states.recoated_repaired: Schmidt-Cassegrain telescope tube crack welded and reinforced, primary recoated; cold-blue reflection smooth again, only a fine scar at the weld.

states.intact: A heavy deep-blue hardback observation log, cover gold-stamped 'Purple Mountain Substation', pages filled in pen with seeing times and seeing conditions.
states.coffee_stained: The same observation log soaked by spilled coffee; cover swollen and wrinkled, writing bled into brown blotches.

states.intact: A dark-green sky-survey off-roader, white 'Beidou One' sprayed on the door, foldable light shield and spare battery box fixed on the roof.
states.cliff_crashed: The dark-green off-roader tumbled off a cliff; body twisted, roof light shield snapped—a wreck that cannot be driven again.

states.young_visitor: Young Shen Xiaoxing: twin sister whose face closely resembles Shen Xiaolan's, same silver-rim glasses, but a vermilion hair ribbon and a small copper-star earring on the right ear, manner bolder.
states.adult_reporter: Adult Shen Xiaoxing: face still nearly identical to adult Shen Xiaolan's, still with vermilion hair ribbon and copper-star earring, interview bag on the shoulder.

E7.name: dome observation room
E7.appearance: A white aluminum summit dome observation room; slit roof opens electrically, equatorial mount holds the telescope at center, darkroom red lamps and star charts on the walls.

E8.name: summit observation platform
E8.appearance: A reinforced-concrete observation platform outside the dome, wind rails around, azimuth marks on the floor, layered seas of cloud beyond.

E9.name: equipment-store dark corridor
E9.appearance: A narrow dark corridor from the dome basement to the equipment store; mirror crates and cable reels stacked on both sides, only emergency lamps giving dull yellow light.

E10.name: abandoned weather station
E10.appearance: An abandoned weather station on the other side of the ridge; brickwork peeling, wind vane rusted dead, empty window frames.

E11.name: memorial brass plaque
E11.appearance: A brass memorial plaque nailed to the granite dome base, engraved with Lu Heng's name and the founding year, verdigris on the edges.

E12.name: filter wheels
E12.appearance: Three ten-centimeter interference filter wheels, aluminum frames marked U, B, V bands, neatly racked on a wooden stand by the scope.

E13.name: Tianshu Two
E13.appearance: A brand-new silver-gray electric sky-survey vehicle, 'Tianshu Two' sprayed on the door, no roof light shield—utterly unlike Beidou One.

E14.name: Director Zhou Min
E14.appearance: Director Zhou Min in his fifties, gray full beard, deep-blue uniform coat of build close to Lu Heng's, but gold station badge on the shoulder boards and a felt hat.

E15.name: darkroom red lamps
E15.appearance: A row of five darkroom red safety lamps hung on iron hooks on the east wall of the dome observation room, shades polished clear.

E16.name: timekeeping copper bells
E16.appearance: Two timekeeping copper bells hung under the dome entrance eaves, bells engraved 'Star Sight', tolling low when wind rises.

E17.name: meteorologist Xiao He
E17.appearance: New meteorologist Xiao He, fifteen or sixteen, silver-rim glasses, at a glance like young Shen Xiaolan, but light-green scarf, shy eyes, no 'Lan' badge on the left sleeve.

E18.name: spare refractor
E18.appearance: A half-person-tall spare refracting telescope, also matte-black tube, but smaller aperture and aluminum folding tripod—not that Schmidt-Cassegrain telescope.

E19.name: ochre pickup
E19.appearance: A stranger ochre pickup with mirror crates in the bed, no Beidou markings—unlike Beidou One.

features.E2: Shen Xiaolan: cyan 'Lan' cloth badge on left sleeve, calm stubborn manner.
features.E6: Shen Xiaoxing: face nearly identical to Shen Xiaolan's, but vermilion hair ribbon, copper-star earring on right ear, bold manner.

lookalike_pairs.note: Twin misID: when only one is present do not draw the other; when both share a segment bind features correctly.

scenes.setting: Dome observation room dusk watch (introduce five darkroom red lamps · two timekeeping copper bells)
actions: At dusk Lu Heng climbs the spiral stair into the dome observation room, presses the button to slit the dome open, the Schmidt-Cassegrain telescope still on the equatorial mount.

actions.action: A row of five darkroom red lamps hangs on the east wall of the dome observation room; Lu Heng polishes each shade.
Two timekeeping copper bells hang under the dome entrance eaves; Lu Heng reaches to let them chime lightly.

actions: Lu Heng circles the Schmidt-Cassegrain telescope on the equatorial mount, checking the primary coating for fingerprints.
Through the slit dome Lu Heng watches the fading sky.

actions.action: The Schmidt-Cassegrain telescope's guidescope locks on Polaris; the matte-black tube catches cold light.

actions: Lu Heng sits in the observing chair and dozes by the darkroom red lamps.
Night wind pours through the slit; Lu Heng tightens the cold-weather coat collar.

scenes.setting: Logging the observation log
actions: Lu Heng opens the observation log and notes that night's seeing grade in pen.
Lu Heng sketches the relative positions of Orion's Belt three stars in the observation log.
Lu Heng closes the observation log and returns it to the wooden box by the console.

actions.action: The Schmidt-Cassegrain telescope tracks slightly; cold-blue coating sweeps Lu Heng's cheek.

actions: Lu Heng gently wipes mist from the eyepiece with a chamois cloth.

scenes.setting: Summit platform greets the intern (introduce three filter wheels)
actions: At dawn on the summit observation platform, Lu Heng greets young Shen Xiaolan driving dark-green Beidou One up.

actions.action: Shen Xiaolan jumps down from Beidou One and hangs the car key on a rail hook.
Lu Heng points to the three filter wheels on the wooden stand by the scope, teaching Shen Xiaolan to read U, B, V bands.
Shen Xiaolan crouches by the platform scale marks, curiously touching the azimuth numbers.
Lu Heng points at the eastern sea of cloud and explains to Shen Xiaolan when twilight begins and ends.
Shen Xiaolan looks back at parked Beidou One, eyes full of longing.

actions: The two lean side by side on the wind rail, listening to wind skim the dome.

scenes.setting: Equipment-store dark corridor (Shen Xiaoxing alone)
actions: In the equipment-store dark corridor, Shen Xiaoxing with a vermilion hair ribbon turns from behind a mirror crate.
Shen Xiaoxing fiddles with a cable reel in the corridor; the copper-star earring glints.
Shen Xiaoxing phones a shot of the old star chart on the wall and smiles boldly.
Shen Xiaoxing carries her interview bag through the shadows of the equipment-store dark corridor.
Emergency lamps flicker; Shen Xiaoxing stops to hear the dome motor overhead.

scenes.setting: Twins shared frame in one segment
actions: On the summit observation platform Shen Xiaolan and sister Shen Xiaoxing stand side by side—one cyan sleeve badge, one vermilion hair ribbon.
Shen Xiaolan hands a filter wheel to Shen Xiaoxing; they smile at each other.
Shen Xiaoxing straightens Shen Xiaolan's silver-rim glasses; the sisters walk slowly along the rail.
Shen Xiaolan and Shen Xiaoxing part at the east end of the platform, each going opposite ways.
Clouds surge; the sisters' backs—one cyan, one red—slowly pull apart.

scenes.setting: Observation log coffee-stained
actions: Months later at night, Lu Heng alone stands watch in the dome observation room; the Schmidt-Cassegrain telescope tracks quietly.

actions.action: Lu Heng opens the observation log and finds the cover soaked by spilled coffee, writing bled.

actions: Lu Heng wipes dew condensed on the Schmidt-Cassegrain telescope eyepiece.
Through the slit dome Lu Heng looks toward the black Milky Way.

actions.action: The Schmidt-Cassegrain telescope's guidescope glints faintly in the dark.

actions: Lu Heng slips the stained observation log into a desiccant bag and sighs.

scenes.setting: Years turn (filler · stretch the interval)
actions: Seasons turn; Lu Heng day after day slits the dome slit on the scheduled sky field.
Another snow night, Lu Heng wraps his coat tight beside the Schmidt-Cassegrain telescope.
Around the spring equinox Lu Heng calibrates the equatorial polar axis inside the dome.
At midsummer noon Lu Heng wipes sun-hot aluminum skin of the dome.
In an autumn typhoon the Schmidt-Cassegrain telescope tracking motor hums low through the wind roar.
Another New Year's Eve Lu Heng alone keeps watch in the dome observation room until dawn.
On a meteor-shower forecast night Lu Heng finishes focus two hours early.
On a full-moon night Lu Heng covers the primary with a light shield against stray light.
When a cold wave hits Lu Heng packs low-temp grease into the equatorial bearings.
Around Qingming Lu Heng clears snow and pine needles on the platform.
In plum-rain season Lu Heng repeatedly checks the dome seals for leaks.
On the first frost of early winter, Lu Heng's white breath drifts under the darkroom red lamps.

scenes.setting: Long night-watch addenda (keep stretching the interval)
actions: Through three moonless nights Lu Heng runs the photometry program again and again.
One night clouds clamp shut; Lu Heng can only close the dome slit and wait.
A cloud gap opens; Lu Heng quickly reaims toward Virgo.
At three a.m. Lu Heng sips cold tea from a thermos.
He sorts number tags on the filter wheels by the console.
Timekeeping copper bells chime lightly in the wind; Lu Heng looks up to listen.
As the horizon pales Lu Heng logs the last seeing times of the night.
Before closing the dome he looks once more at the Schmidt-Cassegrain telescope's intact coating.

scenes.setting: Platform patrol (recall filter wheels · stranger pickup)
actions: At daybreak Lu Heng patrols the summit observation platform; dark-green Beidou One is parked by the rail.

actions.action: Lu Heng crouches to check Beidou One tire pressure and roof light-shield latches.
Lu Heng walks to the wooden stand; those three filter wheels are still neatly racked.
A stranger ochre pickup drives the mountain road, body wide and flat—not Beidou One.
Lu Heng stands by the platform scale marks and logs last night's peak wind speed.
Lu Heng reties the wind net tight on the rail.

actions: Far off the sea of cloud ebbs, revealing deeper valley shadow.

scenes.setting: Storm night (tube cracked · Beidou One crashed)
actions: A storm rises suddenly; the dome observation room shudders in the gale; the Schmidt-Cassegrain telescope sways hard.
Lightning whitens the dome inner wall; Lu Heng lunges for the emergency-stop button.

actions.action: A sharp crack—the Schmidt-Cassegrain telescope tube bursts a lengthwise fissure; coating peels.
On the mountain road dark-green Beidou One skids and jolts in the downpour.
A sideslip sends Beidou One through the guardrail and off the cliff; the roof light shield snaps.
Inside the dome Lu Heng lunges to the equatorial mount and steadies the cracked Schmidt-Cassegrain telescope.

scenes.setting: Aftermath (Beidou One old photo indirect · darkroom red-lamp recall)

actions.action: The day after the storm Lu Heng stands in the dome observation room, staring at the cracked Schmidt-Cassegrain telescope.
Lu Heng fingertips the tube crack, expression dark.
On a sticky note by the star chart Lu Heng writes the date Beidou One was lost.
Above the console hangs an old photo of Beidou One; Lu Heng gazes at it a long time.
Lu Heng takes one of the five darkroom red lamps from the wall and sits alone in the red glow.
The damaged Schmidt-Cassegrain telescope still sits cracked on the equatorial mount; the coating gap glares.

scenes.setting: Repair the telescope (third state · spare-refractor false friend)
actions: Weeks later Lu Heng brings argon welding and coating jigs and begins repairing the Schmidt-Cassegrain telescope.

actions.action: Lu Heng takes a spare refractor from a wooden crate; it resembles the Schmidt-Cassegrain telescope but is smaller.

actions: Lu Heng carefully welds the tube crack and recoats the primary.

actions.action: The last weld is ground smooth; the Schmidt-Cassegrain telescope is recoated and repaired, cold-blue light restored.

actions: The repaired Schmidt-Cassegrain telescope tracks again; Lu Heng looks at it with relief.

scenes.setting: False friends: Tianshu Two and Director Zhou Min

actions.action: A silver-gray Tianshu Two drives onto the summit platform—nothing like the crashed Beidou One.
Director Zhou Min steps onto the platform and talks beside Lu Heng; the two builds are alike.
Zhou Min points at Tianshu Two and explains the new sky-survey roster to Lu Heng.
Tianshu Two horns and drives off; Lu Heng alone on the platform watches it go.

actions: Wind flaps the roster Zhou Min left behind.

scenes.setting: False friend: meteorologist Xiao He who resembles Shen Xiaolan

actions.action: From below comes meteorologist Xiao He in silver-rim glasses; at a glance she somewhat resembles young Shen Xiaolan.
Xiao He practices reading the anemometer; Lu Heng shakes his head—she is never Shen Xiaolan.
meteorologist Xiao He leaves the platform in her light-green scarf; her back fades down the mountain road.

scenes.setting: Injured cane (timekeeping-bell long-range recall)

actions.action: At dusk years later, Lu Heng with gauze at the temple leans on an aluminum cane under the white dome.

actions: Lu Heng leans on the cane and looks up at the tall dome, gaze far away.

actions.action: Those two timekeeping copper bells under the eaves chime lightly in the wind; Lu Heng stops on his cane to listen.

actions: Lu Heng presses a palm to the dome's cold aluminum skin, as if saying goodbye.
He slowly sits on the platform stone steps, splinted leg stretched straight.

scenes.setting: Shen Xiaolan returns · Lu Heng dies

actions.action: By day adult Shen Xiaolan returns along the mountain road and hurries toward the dome.

actions: Shen Xiaolan reunites with cane-leaning Lu Heng under the dome; they embrace.

actions.action: Beside the infirmary narrow bed Shen Xiaolan holds Lu Heng's thick but cold hand.
Lu Heng's breath fades; he finally closes his eyes and passes away.
Shen Xiaolan gently sets Lu Heng's walkie-talkie back by the pillow.

scenes.setting: Relics · memorial brass plaque (indirect mention avoids the deceased)

actions.action: Lu Heng's deep-blue cold-weather coat still hangs behind the dome door; Shen Xiaolan reaches to stroke it lightly.
By the dome base adult Shen Xiaolan stands before a newly nailed memorial brass plaque.
Shen Xiaolan's fingertip traces Lu Heng's name engraved on the memorial brass plaque.

actions: Wind rises; timekeeping copper bells chime far off; Shen Xiaolan lifts her head.

scenes.setting: Sisters reunite (adult twins · long-range return + shared frame)

actions.action: Adult Shen Xiaoxing arrives from below and embraces Shen Xiaolan tightly under the dome.

actions: Shen Xiaolan and Shen Xiaoxing stand side by side by the dome base—one calm, one bold.
The sisters look at each other in silence, facing faces alike yet different.
Shen Xiaoxing opens her recorder, then silently stops it, only standing with her sister.

scenes.setting: Memory flashback (temporal/intent locate · all name-free)
scenes._comment: Each shot uses a temporal phrase for a past image, no names; anchor.resolves_to is for scoring.

actions.action: The shot returns to years ago—that youth touching azimuth numbers by the platform scale marks appears again.

anchor.phrase: the youth touching azimuth numbers by the platform scale marks

actions.action: The opening moment returns—in the dome, a matte-black tube aims at Polaris for the first time.

anchor.phrase: the matte-black tube that first aimed at Polaris at the opening

actions.action: Flash to the dark corridor years ago—that figure with vermilion hair ribbon and copper-star earring slips past.

anchor.phrase: the figure with vermilion hair ribbon in the dark corridor years ago

actions.action: Again that row of five dark-red safety lamps on the dome east wall.

anchor.phrase: that row of five dark-red safety lamps on the dome east wall

actions.action: Back to the reinforced-concrete observation platform of first meeting, seas of cloud surging as before.

anchor.phrase: the reinforced-concrete observation platform of first meeting

scenes.setting: Closing (stained-log long-range return · filter-wheel long-range return)

actions.action: Shen Xiaolan reopens that coffee-stained observation log and walks into the dome observation room.
On the wooden stand by the scope, those three filter wheels are still neatly racked.
Shen Xiaolan takes over the Schmidt-Cassegrain telescope watch; cold-blue coating tracks the night sky again.

actions: The dome slit opens slowly; the Milky Way pours down.
